name: Spark
long_description:
Spark AI is workflow software for solar, storage, and data center developers. We've reviewed and identified over 1 million zoning, permitting, and project-related documents in nearly every jurisdiction in America, so that you can instantly identify project requirements, local sentiment, and fatal flaws in seconds.

We’re trusted by dozens of industry-leading developers representing over 90 gigawatts of project pipeline and $30 billion in financing. Our team combines leadership experience from AI and energy (Microsoft, Apple, Department of Energy, Brex).

launches.title: Spark AI: Stakeholder Intelligence for Data Center Permitting
launches.tagline: See who decides your permit, and how they'll vote, before you break ground
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we're [Julia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wu-julia/) and [Anuj](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anujsaigal/), co-founders of [Spark AI](https://www.sparkhq.ai/).

### **TL;DR**

See who decides your permit, and how they'll vote, before you break ground

Every data center in America has to get through a local zoning board before it gets built. We mapped and tracked every jurisdiction, project, and land use regulation in the country, and we just launched Stakeholder Intelligence, a tool that tells you who's deciding your permit, their voting history, and what's likely to happen next. **If you're developing (or powering) data centers, or know someone who is, we want to talk.**

### ❌ The Problem

Data centers land next to real communities: people who didn't ask for a giant, humming building showing up in their backyard. A lot of them fight it.

That fight runs entirely through local politics: county boards, township councils, zoning authorities. Real people with real voting histories, some of whom love solar and hate data centers, some the reverse, and it shifts constantly.

* Data centers are having the roughest time of any large-scale asset class right now. 42% of gigawatt-scale data center projects announced in 2025 have already run into a local moratorium, suspension, legal challenge, or permit denial. That's not an edge case anymore, it's closer to a 50/50 bet.
* And it's accelerating. Within six months of announcement, \~24% hit that same wall in 2025, nearly triple 2024's rate (8%) and more than triple 2023's (7%).

Federal and state policy get all the coverage. But the actual bottleneck on AI compute buildout sits in a Tuesday night meeting in a county most people can't find on a map, and almost nobody tracks it systematically. Developers either fly someone out to sit through hours of public comment, or they pay consultants a lot of money to tell them what already happened last month.

### ✅ How Spark Works: Stakeholder Intelligence

Stakeholder intelligence surfaces every board member, commissioner, officer’s past decisions, meetings and votes from our databases and web search agents running across the country.

<https://youtu.be/-YclcbrBUh8>

**We watch the game tape for you.** For every authority in the US, you get the meeting video, the transcript, the decision, and our summary of what actually mattered. Topics covered, who said what, what got decided. What used to take someone three hours of watching public comment now takes about thirty seconds of reading.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=113436&key=user_uploads/307611/076af213-dd78-4d58-acf8-c249244260cb)

**NIMBY tracking.** We score every county in the country on data center permitting posture: moratoriums, zoning rules, sentiment grounded in local news coverage, and utility interconnection posture. That rolls into a tier and a score, so you know before you sign a lease whether you're walking into a fight.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=113436&key=user_uploads/307611/21ab4ec3-c751-4de6-845a-2cef9e732d7c)

**Alerts.** Ordinances change, moratoriums get proposed, projects move. We tell you when it happens instead of you finding out from a headline.

### Backstory

Julia grew up in and around factories, in the supply chain corridor between Asia and Latin America, before building data and search infrastructure for Apple's Siri team. Anuj spent a decade financing and building energy infrastructure, at the Department of Energy, SunEdison, and EVgo, before founding his last company, Dataherald (YC W21).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=113436&key=user_uploads/307611/870f82a4-1496-4bc2-b433-a69d13c8ea24)

### Who We Work With

Alphabet (Intersect), NextEra, DE Shaw Renewables, Nodiac, and a set of world class developers and Fortune 500s carrying over 200GW of pipeline between them.

### How You Can Help

If you or anyone in your network is developing data centers, large or small, we want the intro. We're especially trying to connect with people close to Terawulf, Vantage, Equinix, CyrusOne, and Digital Realty.

Reach us at [founders@sparkhq.ai](mailto:founders@sparkhq.ai). Or happy to jump on a call: [**calendar link**](https://calendly.com/d/cyty-zwg-3bb).

launches.title: Spark: Permitting Intelligence for AI Infrastructure
launches.tagline: Spark helps energy infrastructure developers cut through permitting red tape
launches.body:
### TL;DR

With [Spark AI](https://www.sparkhq.ai/), developers can instantly identify permitting requirements and fatal flaws in seconds, not weeks.

We have parsed more than 1 million zoning, permitting, town hall meetings, and project documents. Our systems ingest PDFs, maps, land use codes, moratoria, interconnection queues, and local websites across thousands of jurisdictions.

### Permitting is the silent killer of energy infrastructure projects

An estimated $98 billion in projects were [blocked or delayed](https://www.datacenterwatch.org) in Q2 2025. A one-month delay on a 60 MW data center can [erase $10M in value](https://www.foresight.works/case-study/foresight-driving-projects-blind). Speed to power determines who wins in data center, storage, and generation.

Critical information lives inside thousands of scattered, inconsistent zoning codes, permits, and local records. Teams miss high-potential sites, waste months on weak ones, and get outpaced by competitors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96116&key=user_uploads/129719/ac5a347e-6cae-406e-8867-a98f5d8cd5ba)

### Enter Spark: De-risking Speed to Power

Spark pulls everything into one place and makes permitting intelligence instant.

Spark scans millions of PDFs, maps, land use codes, and local websites to surface permitting rules and community sentiment. What used to take weeks now takes seconds. The same engine evaluates individual parcels or entire data rooms.

https://youtu.be/6wvFwUNPrks

**Rapid Permit Matrix 📄**

We run the permitting gauntlet for hyperscalers, energy developers, and BESS operators at a fraction of the cost and time.

Spark generates a complete permit matrix that captures the legal, procedural, and social landscape of any site. Developers move faster on strong sites and eliminate weak ones early.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96116&key=user_uploads/129719/867df1aa-ea4b-4b25-96a1-003942873b64)

**Social Media Sentiment 👥**

Local opposition begins online long before public hearings. Grassroots groups and Facebook communities shape the approval landscape months in advance.

Spark tracks social media activity across every U.S. county for solar, storage, and data center projects. Users identify relevant groups, engagement patterns, and sentiment before the first meeting hits the calendar.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96116&key=user_uploads/129719/75434906-6ad4-48ab-83f0-4740c6350b2b)

Don’t just take it from us: We’re trusted by dozens of industry-leading developers representing over 90 gigawatts of project pipeline and $30 billion in financing: Cypress Creek Renewables, Standard Solar, Arevon, UGE ([case study](https://sparknotes.beehiiv.com/p/from-bottleneck-to-breakthrough)), DESRI, Dynamic Energy ([case study](https://sparknotes.beehiiv.com/p/dynamic-energy)), and many others.

### Core Team

Our founding team, [Julia Wu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wu-julia/), [Anuj Saigal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anujsaigal/?utm_source=sparknotes.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ai-for-a-mission-recruiting-post), [Luca Marturana](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lucamarturana/?utm_source=sparknotes.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ai-for-a-mission-recruiting-post), [Wendell Beane](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wendell-beane-21861712b/), [Shivam Agarwal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivam-agarwal-77604ab8/), combines years of leadership in AI and energy.

We come from Apple, Microsoft, SunEdison, the Department of Energy, and multiple YC startups.

### Our Ask

We’re partnering with developers and operators building the future of compute and energy. If that’s you, we’d love to chat! [**Book a demo here**](https://calendly.com/d/4qp-yyt-qxw/spark-ai-demo)**, or reach out to [founders@sparkhq.ai](mailto:founders@sparkhq.ai)**

We are hiring across [operations/growth](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/spark/jobs/UKGQ0Fd-spark-ai-growth-and-operations-associate-manager) and [engineering](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/spark/jobs/kDeJlPK-software-engineer-full-stack-founding-team)! If this mission sounds exciting to you or someone you know, reach out to [hiring@sparkhq.ai](mailto:hiring@sparkhq.ai)

launches.title: ⚡️ Spark - AI-powered workflows for large-scale clean energy development
launches.tagline: We help large-scale clean energy developers break ground faster
launches.body:
**😎 TL;DR**

[Spark](https://www.sparkhq.ai/) is an AI-powered planning and workflow tool for large-scale clean energy developers that lets them break ground faster. Tae and Julia were previously engineering and product leaders at Tesla, Apple, and Brex.

We are trusted by award-winning solar and battery developers with nearly 1 GW of projects across the US. If you are a utility or community-scale developer, [book a call with us](https://calendly.com/d/4qp-yyt-qxw/spark-demo) to learn more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78596&key=user_uploads/129719/b48282f6-7002-4eba-92e9-dc5307a6c58e)

**🔌 The Problem**

We are in the midst of a generational energy transition, with solar deployment expanding at an annualized rate of roughly [$500B](https://twitter.com/patrickc/status/1698496805162353029) globally, and the Inflation Reduction Act unleashing another [$400B](https://www.mckinsey.com/industries/public-sector/our-insights/the-inflation-reduction-act-heres-whats-in-it) in federal funding. To meet the soaring demand for clean energy, the US must [build](https://www.motherjones.com/environment/2023/04/electrify-everything-scope-data/) an equivalent amount of clean generation by 2035 to the total electricity supplied by all sources today.

Despite this rapid deployment, utility-scale clean energy developers often spend months assessing and preparing their projects for financing and construction due to varying policies, interconnection, and permitting requirements across jurisdictions. This pre-construction phase is an error-prone and manual effort of researching and aggregating data across thousands of PDFs, websites, and maps.

Many developers find themselves poring over 1000-page documents, engaging expensive consultants, or focusing on a limited number of jurisdictions.

Through hundreds of conversations with developers, we consistently hear that navigating this "complex patchwork of jurisdictions, where every state is a snowflake," is a major obstacle.

**✨ Enter Spark**

With Spark, developers can identify requirements, risks, and incentives by leveraging our curated dataset. They can now screen prospective projects in seconds, not weeks.

For the first time, Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a dramatically simplified method to extract grid interconnection and permitting requirements, zoning ordinances, economics (rates, tax credits, RECs), and a range of unstructured information relevant to renewables development.

By refining the data specifically for this industry, Spark introduces a new way for developers to navigate through otherwise disparate and cumbersome information.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78596&key=user_uploads/295458/976413d4-584e-44fd-8c6e-315509d4c9de)

These insights are then precisely mapped to individual counties and parcels of land, accelerating the development process significantly.

However, Spark’s capabilities extend beyond location diligence and requirement aggregation. Our goal is to re-imagine the development workflow, enabling developers to drastically reduce the time dedicated to mundane tasks such as research, documentation, and portfolio management.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78596&key=user_uploads/129719/550c9a08-294e-4944-9369-649919faca48)

One of our customers, an industry veteran with nearly 20 years of experience, said “I see this tool as my Jarvis.”

Our mission is to empower developers to prioritize human interactions and make strategic decisions about where to invest millions of dollars to electrify the nation’s grid — not the manual, back office work.

[🪄](mailto:founders@sparkhq.ai) **The (Dream) Team**

[Tae](https://www.linkedin.com/in/taehnkim/) built software while sitting inside the Model 3 factory at Tesla, wrote payment systems that processed millions in EV sales as a founding engineer at Lucid Motors’ commerce team, and helped Gen Z find love at Tinder.

[Julia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wu-julia/) was an engineering manager on the team that automated fraud alerts and dispute filing at Brex. She also built search and cloud infrastructure at Apple and Microsoft and bankrolled her passion for crypto through hackathon prizes on nights and weekends.

Hailing from São Paulo, Brazil, where we lived ten minutes apart after our parents immigrated from Korea and China, we embarked on our American dream at 18 for undergraduate degrees in STEM at Georgia Tech and Brown University. Our paths crossed many years later in New York City, through a shared passion for software engineering, infrastructure for society, and startups.

**⚡️ Energized yet?**

Are you (or do you know) a developer of utility or community-scale solar/storage projects? [Book a demo](https://calendly.com/d/4qp-yyt-qxw/spark-demo) or reach out to [founders@sparkhq.ai!](mailto:founders@sparkhq.ai)

launches.title: Dataherald - NL-to-SQL API for developers
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Dataherald enables you to embed Natural Language to SQL (“NL-to-SQL”) into your product. The NL-to-SQL API, built with an LLM (such as GPT), allows users to conduct no-code data analytics, pull reports, and conduct complex data queries using just natural language.

Hi, we’re [Amir](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amir-zohrenejad-72a517184/) and [Anuj](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anujsaigal/) from [Dataherald](https://www.dataherald.com/contact). There have been countless game-changing applications of AI, but one area that has remained uncharted is NL-to-SQL. But fear not - we’re changing that. We’ve built a cutting-edge NL-to-SQL engine, meticulously crafted to be the fastest and most accurate in the market, delivering an unmatched developer experience!

**The Problem**

Developers struggle to build NL-to-SQL into products because LLMs do not work out-of-the-box. LLMs do not:

1. Utilize metadata and business definitions since they are not already stored in the relational database
2. Conduct **complex** SQL queries, such as self joins, multiple sub-queries, or rarer operations like windowing, partitioning, lags, temporal calculations, etc.
3. Create NL-to-SQL training dataset(s) for fine-tuned models
4. Assess the accuracy of AI-generated SQL

**The Solution**

Dataherald’s API solves these challenges by allowing developers to:

* Add business context from various sources (data dictionaries, DBT, Confluence docs, Google docs, etc.)

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/kwye-PT4ors7WmWLdm5AjZN5oprn0XXX2v4i_PkCIYwRvilZ-fixK_9wJGHJo9PU1rjv99kBgEVCB1YX58DYO3HCeNoQlHqLcdURUilLhsYcdiDTVEVcd8DZCrt_1EeHYd-zkjWUukA6I8Ka8epVBCc)

* Identify relevant data tables
* Fine-tune NL-to-SQL LLMs **(including GPT-4!)** specific to their data
* Assess confidence levels in AI-generated SQL

All this happens with a few simple API calls.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/6LVhL2Hbyga7oQ7mGDNORds_IMhmA5oBbrjNjKl4Y3L3rECk4WozWzJQY8jS16X6j9ZGgW-5p1fVqt6flbiZfR138EpYhUmcH9btyJL1ky_y7EIlQ5lEQUYVVVzfzDkjlfDU88y_0mJwDRbMgXWug9M)

Dataherald’s NL-to-SQL API unlocks data access wherever needed:

1. Enabling Complex Data Queries in SaaS Apps: For example a large payroll software company uses Dataherald to embed NL-to-SQL into their front end so that users can ask questions like “How much did I spend on full stack engineers in our European offices in Q2 2023 and how is that trending?”
2. Democratizing Data Insights: Companies integrate our API into Slack, enabling self-serve data requests, and freeing up valuable time for data analysts.
3. Automate Customer Support with Chatbots: Customer support teams dealing with data-heavy queries leverage Dataherald in chatbots, automating inquiries regarding user data.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/rsI_mjIShLSNZBuwGtOKk8k8Fv0f8rUEjItn0w17y-_rps3jWcWNgvQ6C9Ly9EFxszG7jE3c5DLS_T9lcEiHwYD0Z1nvXNgHB3-qFRAOJM6XL6B0w19JQt_esYJm7qqp6Tg2U1Jh9QvHlWGdohmzUZ4)

**The ASK**

* **Start using today** - send me an email [anuj@dataherald.com](https://mailto:anuj@dataherald.com) to get your API key and start using it today!
* **Share** - tell your colleagues and friends about [Dataherald](https://dataherald.com/)
* **YC Companies** - skip the wait list and claim the [YC deal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/deals/2135) 
* **Open-source engine** is available on [Github](https://github.com/Dataherald)

launches.title: 🚀 Dataherald - Query your structured database in natural language
launches.tagline: Enable anyone to get answers to ad hoc data questions in seconds – no SQL needed
launches.body:
### The TL;DR

Rather than waiting hours or days, business users get answers to complex data questions in seconds – all in plain English. Dataherald’s AI-powered natural language to SQL agent gives you answers, fast. It’s like having a data analyst on standby 24/7.

👋 Howdy! - we’re [Amir](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amir-zohrenejad-72a517184/) and [Anuj](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anujsaigal/); we’re building [Dataherald](https://dataherald.com/). We’re on a mission to enable anyone to get answers to their data questions immediately. No longer do you have to click through dozens of BI dashboards or “wait on the data team” to get the answers you need.

### The Problem

With an ever-increasing volume of data, businesses have invested heavily in BI tools with the aim of providing answers to data questions. These tools often fail to handle complex data queries, leading to a backlog of **ad hoc questions** for the data team, inevitably creating a bottleneck.

**The Data BI “Doom Loop” —** Dashboards inevitably fall short in answering certain data questions, leaving people waiting.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73999&key=user_uploads/307611/9c21d382-337a-4bcf-9d06-27be4cd90a5f)

### The Solution

Business users want answers to their data questions in the most natural way possible - by simply posing a question in plain language and receiving a response in the same natural language format.

Dataherald cuts through the noise, providing quick answers to complex data questions, all in plain English. Users Slack their queries to our bot and receive instant responses.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73999&key=user_uploads/307611/9daf452e-4d9e-44a3-b41b-6594bea0391d)

Our natural language-to-SQL agent, supported by an LLM, comprehends questions, identifies relevant data tables, writes SQL queries, and assesses confidence levels in responses. If confidence is low, a member of your data team can review and modify the SQL. Best of all, Dataherald's algorithm continuously improves, delivering more accurate insights over time. Watch the product in action in the link below!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73999&key=user_uploads/307611/a55a7b9c-94dd-480d-a489-9393ba36c380)

###
